title: Disguises
description: use and craft disguises against mobs.
body:
# Disguise Mod

The **Disguise Mod** lets you disguise yourself as mobs, causing them to ignore you.  

## Features

- **Craftable Mob Heads**  
  You can now craft mob heads directly instead of relying on charged creepers.  
  *(Crafting recipes shown in the images.)*  

- **Mob Interaction**  
  Wearing the corresponding mob head makes that type of mob ignore you.  

- **Ender Dragon Head**  
  Wearing an **Ender Dragon** head causes most common mobs to ignore you.
